headline: Ceasefire is threatened as Israel expands Lebanon strikes and Iran closes strait again
summary: A ceasefire to pause the war in Iran appears to be hanging by a thread after Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz again in response to Israeli attacks in Lebanon. Israel has expanded its strikes in Lebanon.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key transit route for a large share of global seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: Iran's renewed closure of the Strait of Hormuz, in response to Israeli strikes in Lebanon, puts an existing ceasefire at risk. Threats to Gulf shipping routes typically raise oil prices and risk premia.
